topic: Sorting REAL ID Documents as a Non-Citizen

script.title: THE REAL ID COUNTER
script.scene_zh: 車管處 · REAL ID 窗口
script.intro_zh: 五份文件，一次緊張的辦證之行。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to the REAL ID document counter. Listen for words that keep papers happy.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到 REAL ID 的文件窗口。留意那些讓文件乖乖配合的說法。
script.outro: That's a REAL ID sorted calmly. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: REAL ID 就這樣安頓好了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat every line together now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起把每句跟讀一遍。
script.char_a_description: a slim woman in her early thirties with straight black hair cut at the chin, thin round glasses, gold hoop earrings, a camel trench coat over a cream sweater, and a small brown handbag
script.char_b_description: a tall man in his thirties with closely cropped black hair, a clean-shaven face, a light grey button-up shirt with a DMV badge lanyard, and broad shoulders

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, I booked a REAL ID appointment.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔɹnɪŋ aɪ ˈbʊkt ə ˈɹiəl ˌaɪ ˈdi əˈpɑɪntmənt/
dialogue.zh: 早安，我預約了辦 REAL ID 的時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning! May I check your appointment number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔɹnɪŋ meɪ aɪ ˈtʃɛk jɔɹ əˈpɑɪntmənt ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 早安，請問你的預約號碼是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's here… B-four-two-one, on this text message.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts hɪɹ ˌbi fɔɹ ˈtu ˈwʌn ˈɑn ðɪs ˈtɛkst ˈmɛsɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡…簡訊上寫 B421。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it. Take a seat by the third window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfaʊnd ɪt ˈteɪk ə ˈsit baɪ ðə θɝd ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 找到了。請到三號窗口旁邊坐下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Is this the line for new IDs?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθæŋk ju ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈlaɪn fɔɹ ˈnu aɪ di ˈzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問要在這裡排隊辦新卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one handles new applications, you're in luck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn ˈhændɚlz ˈnu ˌæpləˈkeɪʃənz jʊɹ ɪn ˈlʌk/
dialogue.zh: 這個窗口就是收新申請的，你運氣不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, because the website confused me a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɹeɪt bɪˈkɑz ðə ˈwɛbsaɪt kənˈfjuzd mi ə ˈlɪɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那個網站害我一頭霧水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair. So, are you a U.S. citizen or not?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɛɹ soʊ ɑɹ ju ə ˌju ˈɛs ˈsɪtɪzənɚ ɔɹ ˈnɑt/
dialogue.zh: 這很正常。請問你是美國公民嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not a citizen, I hold a work visa here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɑt ə ˈsɪtɪzənɚ aɪ ˈhoʊld ə ˈwɝk ˈvizə hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 不是公民，我持工作簽證留在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfectly fine, REAL ID works for visa holders too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪktli ˈfaɪn ˈɹiəl ˌaɪ ˈdi wɝks fɔɹ ˈvizə ˈhoʊldɚz tu/
dialogue.zh: 完全沒問題，REAL ID 也核發給簽證持有者。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good. I worried I didn't qualify at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd aɪ ˈwɝɪd aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈkwɑləfaɪ ɑt ˈɔl/
dialogue.zh: 噢那就好，我還擔心自己根本不合格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You do. Now, what documents did you bring?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju du naʊ wʌt ˈdɑkjəmənts dɪd ju ˈbɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你符合。好，你帶來哪些文件？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My passport, my visa page, and my work permit card.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpæspɔɹt maɪ ˈvizə ˈpeɪdʒ ænd maɪ ˈwɝk pɚˈmɪt ˈkɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 我的護照、簽證頁，還有工作許可卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Do you have a Social Security card too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd du ju ˈhæv ə ˈsoʊʃəl ˈsɛkɚɹi ˈkɑɹd tu/
dialogue.zh: 好。社會安全卡也有帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right here, plus two mail pieces, like the email said.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt hɪɹ plʌs tu ˈmeɪl ˈpisəz laɪk ði ˈimeɪl ˈsɛd/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，還有兩份郵件，就像 email 裡寫的那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look… hmm, the mail is a little old.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi lʊk ˈhəm ðə ˈmeɪl ɪz ə ˈlɪɾəl ˈoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 我看看…嗯，郵件舊了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How old is too old? They're from last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈoʊld ɪz tu ˈoʊld ðɛɹ fɹʌm ˈlæst ˈmuθ/
dialogue.zh: 多舊才算太舊？這是上個月的耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Last month is actually perfect, I misread it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlæst ˈmuθ ɪz ˈæktʃuəli ˈpɝfɪkt aɪ ˌmɪzˈɹɛd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 上個月剛剛好，其實是我看錯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, you had me nervous for a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ju ˈhæd mi ˈnɝvəs fɚ ə ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 好啦，你害我緊張了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry about that. One thing: the names don't match.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi əˈbaʊt ðæt wʌn θɪŋ ðə ˈneɪmz ˈdoʊnt ˈmætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉。有個小狀況：名字不太一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you mean? They're both my name.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du ju min ðɛɹ boθ maɪ ˈneɪm/
dialogue.zh: 什麼意思？兩張上面都是我的名字呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your passport shows a middle name, the work card doesn't.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ ˈpæspɔɹt ʃoʊz ə ˈmɪdəl ˈneɪm ðə wɝk kɑɹd ˈdəzənt/
dialogue.zh: 你的護照上有中間名，工作卡上卻沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! That… um, is that really a problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt ʌm ɪz ˈðæt ˈɹɪli ə ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 噢！那個…嗯，這真的算問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing huge, but I'll flag it on the form.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ hjudʒ bʌt aɪl ˈflæɡ ɪt ˈɑn ðə ˈfɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 不算大問題，但我會在表格上註記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that slow down the card by mail?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðæt sloʊ daʊn ðə ˈkɑɹd baɪ meɪl/
dialogue.zh: 那卡片寄過來會不會變慢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe a few days, they're strict about matching names.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ə fju deɪz ðɛɹ stɹɪkt əˈbaʊt ˈmætʃɪŋ neɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 也許多等幾天，名字比對他們很嚴格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then please write a note, I'd rather wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pliːz ˈɹaɪt ə noʊt aɪd ˈɹæðɚ ˈweɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就請你寫個備註，我寧可多等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Next, we need a vision test, ever had one?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn nɛkst wi nid ə ˈvɪʒən tɛst ˈɛvɚ hæd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 寫好了。接著要做視力測驗，你以前做過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only when I got glasses back home, years ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɛn aɪ ɡɑt ˈɡlæsəz bæk hoʊm jɪɹz əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 只有從前在家鄉配眼鏡時做過一回。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same idea, just read these letters out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm aɪˈdiə dʒʌst ɹid ðiz ˈlɛɾɚz aʊt laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 一樣的概念，跟著唸這些字母就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure... E, F, P, G... did I miss one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ i ˈɛf ˈpi dʒi ˈdɪɾaɪ ˈmɪs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 好…E、F、P、G…我有漏掉一個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All right, you passed, no worries today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ˈɹaɪt ju pæst noʊ ˈwɝɪz təˈde/
dialogue.zh: 很好，你通過了，今天不用擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. My eyes have gotten worse, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs maɪ aɪz hæv ˈɡɑɾən wɝs ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，老實說我眼睛真的壞了不少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me about it, mine go in the afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ɪt maɪn ɡoʊ ɑn ði ˌæfɚˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，我到了下午眼睛也會累。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Haha, so when does my picture get taken?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑhɑ soʊ wɛn dʌz maɪ ˈpɪktʃɚ ɡɛt ˈteɪkən/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，那什麼時候拍我的照片？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right after this, stand by the yellow line there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ˈæftɚ ðɪs stænd baɪ ðə ˈjɛloʊ laɪn ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 辦完這個就拍，站到那邊的黃線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take my glasses off? The website says...
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ teɪk maɪ ˈɡlæsəz ɔf ðə ˈwɛbsaɪt sɛz/
dialogue.zh: 那要把眼鏡摘下來嗎？網站上好像寫…

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them on if you wear them daily, that's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðəm ɑn ɪf ju wɛɚ ðəm ˈdeɪli ðæts faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 天天戴就戴著吧，那樣沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I'd squint like an owl without them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪd skwɪnt laɪk ən ˈaʊl wɪˈðaʊt ðəm/
dialogue.zh: 好，不戴的話我會像貓頭鷹一樣瞇眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, owls actually photograph well. Ready when you are.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈaʊlz ˈæktʃuəli ˈfoʊtoʊɡɹæf wɛl ˈɹɛdi wɛn ju ɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，貓頭鷹其實很上相。準備好了就說一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready... was that the real picture or a test?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɛdi wʌz ðæt ðə ˈɹiəl ˈpɪktʃɚ ɔɹ ə ˈtɛst/
dialogue.zh: 好了…那張是正式照片還是試拍？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The real one, and you look great, no reshoot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɹiəl wʌn ænd ju lʊk ɡɹeɪt noʊ ˈɹiʃut/
dialogue.zh: 是正式的那張，你很好看，不用重拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew, I blinked three times on my last photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /fju aɪ ˈblɪŋkt θɹi ˈtaɪmz ɑn maɪ ˈlæst ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 呼，我上次拍照連眨了三次眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happens all day here, we just keep shooting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpənz ɔl deɪ hɪɹ wi dʒʌst kip ˈʃutɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我在這兒天天都遇到，就一直重拍就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long until the card gets here by mail?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈlɔŋ ʌnˈtɪl ðə kɑɹd ɡɛts hɪɹ baɪ meɪl/
dialogue.zh: 那卡片多久會寄到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually two to four weeks, to your mailing address.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli tu tə fɔɹ wɪks tə jɔɹ ˈmeɪlɪŋ əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 通常兩到四週，寄到你登記的地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four weeks... um, my license expires before that.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ wɪks ʌm maɪ ˈlaɪsəns ɪkˈspaɪɚz bɪˈfɔɹ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 四週…嗯，我的駕照在那之前就會過期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll print you a paper temporary ID right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl prɪnt ju ə ˈpeɪpɚ ˈtɛmpəˌɹɛɾəɹi ˌaɪ di ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就幫你印一張臨時的紙本證照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the paper one accepted at the airport?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈpeɪpɚ wʌn əkˈsɛptɪd æt ði ˈɛɹˌpɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 安檢收不收紙本的呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with your passport you're fine until it arrives.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɪð jɔɹ ˈpæspɔɹt jʊɹ faɪn əntɪl ɪt əˈɹaɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 可以，搭配護照，新卡寄到前都沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, that was my big fear, flying next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ðæt wəz maɪ bɪɡ fɪɹ ˈflaɪɪŋ nɛkst muθ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那正是我最大的擔憂，我下個月要搭飛機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Common worry, half our walk-ins ask that same thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑmən ˈwɝi hæf ˈaʊɹ ˈwɔkɪnz æsk ðæt seɪm θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 很常見的擔憂，一半臨櫃來的人都會問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, can people walk in without an appointment?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt kæn ˈpipəl wɔk ɪn wɪˈðaʊt ən əˈpɑɪntmənt/
dialogue.zh: 等等，不用預約也能直接走進來辦嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for renewals, new applications need the slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli fɔɹ rɪˈnulz nu ˌæpləˈkeɪʃənz nid ðə slɑt/
dialogue.zh: 只有到期換照可以臨櫃，新辦一定要約時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know, I almost skipped booking online.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ aɪ ˈoʊlmoʊst skɪpt ˈbʊkɪŋ ˌɑnˈlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 還好問清楚，我差點就沒在線上預約。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your receipt and the tracking code, keep it safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz jɔɹ rɪˈsit ænd ðə ˈtɹækɪŋ koʊd kip ɪt seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 這是你的收據與追蹤碼，好好收著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll snap a photo, paper never survives my pockets.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl snæp ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ˈpeɪpɚ ˈnɛvɚ sɚˈvaɪvz maɪ ˈpɑkɪts/
dialogue.zh: 我拍張照片存起來，紙條在我口袋從來活不久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart habit. The fee was already paid online, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈhæbɪt ðə fi wəz ɑlˈɹɛdi peɪd ˌɑnˈlaɪn ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 聰明的習慣。費用你已經在網路繳過了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, thirty-eight dollars, card, no problem at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈθɜɾi ˈeɪt ˈdɑlɚz kɑɹd noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 對，三十八元，刷卡付的，完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All done, enjoy your first REAL ID, and drive safe!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl dʌn ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jɔɹ fɝst ˈɹiəl ˌaɪ di ænd draɪv seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 全部完成，好好享受你的第一張 REAL ID，開車小心！

script.youtube_title: 【新辦REAL ID🪪】「貓頭鷹其實很上相」🦉👓｜聽完自己搞定文件櫃台｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜REAL ID Counter
script.youtube_title_en: "Owls Actually Photograph Well" — Getting a REAL ID as a Visa Holder
script.youtube_description:
「貓頭鷹其實很上相」——持工作簽證住在美國，第一次辦 REAL ID 要帶哪些文件？名字對不上怎麼辦？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在車管處的 REAL ID 窗口。

你會聽到：報預約號碼、確認非公民也能申辦；層層核對護照、簽證頁、工作許可卡、社會安全卡與兩份地址郵件；護照多了一個中間名時怎麼註記與等待；視力測驗、拍照、臨時紙本證照能不能過安檢；還有新卡郵寄到府要幾週的真實問答。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，就是美國人櫃台對話的語感：um、oh、haha、phew、tell me about it。聽完你就會用：I booked a REAL ID appointment、What documents did you bring、Do you have a Social Security card too、no problem at all。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先熟，腦袋自然記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。
